metric_validity_gate.threshold_provenance: Published clinical threshold for intracranial hypertension. AANS Brain Trauma Foundation guidelines: ICP > 22 mmHg requires treatment. We use 25 mmHg as the hard safety limit.
metric_validity_gate.physical_meaning: ICP > 25 mmHg = intracranial hypertension. Sustained elevation risks herniation, brain compression, death.
metric_validity_gate.clinical_relevance: Direct clinical endpoint. This is what physicians monitor and treat.
metric_validity_gate.comparator_sensitivity: A working drainage system keeps ICP < 25 mmHg. A failing system allows ICP > 25 mmHg. The metric distinguishes them.
metric_validity_gate.failure_sensitivity: Captures the actual failure mode (dangerous ICP), not a proxy (drainage volume).

frozen_criterion.pass_condition: Distributed survival >= 24h AND single-segment survival < 24h in >= 8 of 10 scenarios
